/privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy – Fintra
/privacy-policy.description: Learn how Fintra collects, uses, and protects your data across our platform.
p: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our platform and services.
We may collect your name, email address, and contact details when you sign up, contact us, or use our services.
We collect information about how you use our services, such as your interaction with our website, including the pages you visit and the time spent on those pages.
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to monitor activity on our services and store certain information. This helps us analyze trends and improve user experience.
If you make purchases, we collect payment information such as credit card numbers and billing addresses to process transactions securely. This data is protected and not shared with third parties.
We may collect your preferences regarding how we communicate with you, including your consent to receive marketing materials, newsletters, and other communications from us.

We collect information about the device you use to access our services, including device type, operating system, unique device identifiers, and mobile network information, to enhance security and optimize user experience.
